title: 'Scourge' of abuse must be rooted out, says Pope, during Lourdes visit
snippet: Pope Leo spoke to bishops before leading a service attended by thousands of worshippers in France.

title: Ten climbers missing after avalanche hits Himalayan base camp
snippet: The Nepali team was preparing to take overseas climbers up the Himlung Himal peak.
